subject.title: fix(copilot): keep tool transcript groups structurally complete

question: Should `appendSessionTranscriptMessagesByIdentity` be accepted as the durable plugin-SDK seam for atomic transcript groups, with incomplete Copilot tool groups intentionally omitted after an interruption or hook block?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive session-state and SDK-boundary decision; automated review cannot establish the intended long-term public contract or audit-retention policy.

options.title: Approve the generic seam
options.body: Accept the reusable batch API and the fail-closed group omission policy after reviewing its upgrade and plugin-SDK contract.

options.title: Narrow the seam
options.body: Keep atomic persistence internal to the Copilot owner until a cross-harness transcript-group contract is designed and documented.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic seam
recommendation.body: Accept the reusable batch API and the fail-closed group omission policy after reviewing its upgrade and plugin-SDK contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Copilot transcript journal and its proposed runtime integration are authored and assigned by this contributor.
